mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 54 degrees with clear skies out at Reddan Soccer Park and we are currently under a new moon.

The City of Verona has recently reached two major milestones, including maintaining a Moody's Aa1 rating and the unanimous adoption of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to manage future development.
There is a great lineup ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga tomorrow and multiple trivia nights early next week.
In our weekly report, on September 28, a 16-year-old was cited for reckless driving and operating an eMoto without a license or insurance after a collision.
Stop by for some Caramel Cashew, our flavor of the day, when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
